title: Build your site
intro: Start with a complete editable draft, then review and activate it.
active: Site activated. Your pages are published.
review: Review these draft pages. Edit the sample content before activation.
activation_notice: Activation publishes these pages and switches the homepage, primary menu, language, default theme and identity. Existing content is kept.
name: Site name
draft_notice: Creates draft pages and an unassigned menu. Your current website changes only after activation. All sample content is editable.
wizard_intro: Choose a design, then add what you know about your project. Optional fields can stay empty; every page remains editable. Your current site stays unchanged until you review and activate the new site.
description_help: What do you offer, and to whom? This appears on the home page and in its search description.
services_field: List 1 to 6 services or topics, one per line (optional)
services_help: Each line becomes an offering title. For a magazine, list the subjects you cover. Leave it empty to keep editable examples.
contact_help: These details appear on the contact page after activation. This email is the default contact form recipient; explicit recipients in form settings take priority. Review mail settings and verify receipt from the readiness screen. Empty fields preserve existing settings.
images_help: Choose images from the media library or upload through the image picker. Leave the hero empty to use the theme's original artwork, and leave the logo empty to preserve the current logo.
